gloss: best time to see; peak viewing season

definitions.gloss: best time to see; peak viewing season; in full bloom/color
definitions.explanation: The optimal time to view something, especially flowers, autumn leaves, or other natural scenery at their most beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見頃|みごろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms have reached their peak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見頃|みごろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十一月|じゅういちがつ}→十一月：00635_juuichigatsu⟧⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧ごろだ。
examples.english: The best time to see autumn leaves is around mid-November.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖冬|だんとう}→暖冬：21745_dantou⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見頃|みごろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}かった→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: This year was a mild winter, so the peak plum blossom season came earlier than usual.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used for cherry blossoms (⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧), autumn leaves (⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧), and other seasonal flowers. A key word in Japanese seasonal culture and tourism. Often seen in weather forecasts and travel guides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見頃|みごろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach peak viewing time)
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見頃|みごろ} (peak cherry blossom season)
- ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見頃|みごろ} (peak autumn foliage season)
- {見頃|みごろ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (viewing season information)
